Hymn 17: Awake, Ye Saints of God, Awake!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Eliza R. Snow

This is hymn number 17 titled "Awake, Ye Saints of God, Awake!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
